summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Hermus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos; distinct from Cleopatra daughter of Boreas, wife of Meleager, and wife of Phineus.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Cleopatra fourth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. When the twelve sons of Egyptus by Caliadne cast lots for the Polyxo maidens, Hermus drew Cleopatra. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus names the man she killed as Metalces rather than Hermus.
